# A comment above a parenthesised else branch that is cuddled onto the colon.
celfmt -i src.cel -o out1.cel
! stderr .
cmp out1.cel want.txt

# Verify idempotency; the comment was dropped on the second pass.
celfmt -i out1.cel -o out2.cel
! stderr .
cmp out1.cel out2.cel

# The same with the comment on the parenthesis line.
celfmt -i trailing.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_trailing.txt

celfmt -i want_trailing.txt
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_trailing.txt

-- src.cel --
state.a ? state.b :
	// c
	(
		state.d ? state.e : state.f
	)
-- want.txt --
state.a ?
	state.b
:
	// c
	state.d ? state.e : state.f
-- trailing.cel --
state.a ? state.b :
	( // c
		state.d ? state.e : state.f
	)
-- want_trailing.txt --
state.a ?
	state.b
:
	// c
	state.d ? state.e : state.f
